construction: Authored fictional US street-line, unit, lot, box and basement cases, grouped by the USPS Publication 28 rule each one exercises (subset = group)
Coarse reference values are literal input substrings (the lexical source segment); units, lots, floors and basements are `unit`, box families are `po_box`, the whole street line is one `road` value
Cases whose only assertion was conservation of an unclassifiable value are omitted; the route-plus-bare-value case is a partial reference with the unit left unknown
Every case was checked against private source rows before publication; shapes taken from real rows were rewritten as fictional look-alikes

history: Authored for parser development; development-exposed, not independent heldout evidence

family_policy: One authored family per case; no rendering siblings.

license.notice: Original fictional examples, licensed with this repository. No upstream rows, private listings, customer data or real delivery claims.

provenance.source: Original contributor-authored fictional fixtures (USPS Publication 28 sections cited per group)

split_policy: All rows are conformance; future heldouts require separate custody and family/exact-overlap audit.
